newsitem.title: USA: HOUSTON INDUSTRIES SETS MERGER PRORATION.
newsitem.headline: HOUSTON INDUSTRIES SETS MERGER PRORATION.

text.p: Houston Industries Inc said on Thursday it set a preliminary proration factor of 83.1 percent for NorAm Energy Corp holders who opted for cash in exchange for shares Houston acquired in its merger with NorAm.
Houston and NorAm completed their merger yesterday, forming one of the largest combined electric and natural gas companies in the nation.

Houston said of the 149.7 million shares of NorAm common stock outstanding, holders of about 103.3 million shares elected to take cash while holders of about 37.1 million shares elected to receive Houston common stock.
As provided by the merger pact, the number of NorAm shares converted into cash was limited by tax considerations, and cash elections were oversubscribed, Houston said.
NorAm shareholders who elected Houston common stock would receive stock, as would shareholders who did not make an election by the deadline, Houston said.
Shareholders who elected cash would receive about 83.1 percent of the cash requested and would receive the balance of their compensation in Houston stock.
